name: Laura Azra Aprilyanti
tagline: From Managing Products to Building Them: A Reimagined Web Developer.
aboutParagraphs: Building on my background in Computer Science, I initially leaned into product strategy and project management—aligning user needs with business goals. That hands-on PM experience deepened my understanding of how successful software is planned, structured, and delivered.

To complete the picture, I expanded back into technical execution to directly build what I once managed. Mastering modern tools like React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS allows me to combine a Project Manager's strategic vision with strong front-end craftsmanship to create clean, responsive digital products.
